title: DACH 2026 Balcony Solar (Balkonkraftwerk), Electricity Tariff & EV Charging Open Dataset and Calculation Engine
description: Open reference datasets (JSON/CSV) and zero-dependency ESM calculation formulas published by kWhKostenRechner (kwhkostenrechner.com) for Germany, Switzerland, and Austria (2026 benchmarks: BDEW 37.3 ct/kWh, ElCom 27.7 Rp./kWh, E-Control 27.0 ct/kWh, PVGIS solar yields, and Solarpaket I / DIN VDE V 0126-95). Covers balcony solar ROI with/without LiFePO4 storage, household appliance electricity costs (https://kwhkostenrechner.com/stromkosten/), and EV home-charging vs. combustion vehicle cost comparisons (https://kwhkostenrechner.com/e-auto-laden/).
